roadmap.missable: Only one trophy is missable: Positive Mental Attitude. The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Do it when Lucia offers it in the morning after Down to Earth.

steps.text: Play the story through and enjoy it. There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay, so nothing to watch for except one thing: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — both count toward the 100% checklist later. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave). Cheats disable trophies and saving, so do not use them.
steps.title: Finish the story, do optional missions as they appear

steps.text: After the credits the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations and 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing toward it is missable; everything is doable in free-roam.
steps.title: 100% Completion Checklist and 70 of 80 challenges

steps.text: Finish the stranger strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete — 8 in total), mop up whatever trophies are left, and the platinum pops. Only one trophy is still unconfirmed (Bad Luck, I Guess); everything else is nailed down.
steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and final cleanup

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no multiplayer and no DLC requirement — it is a single-player platinum, roughly 200 hours across the story, the 100% checklist and cleanup. It pops the moment the last of the 54 is earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops the moment the mission ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 1; it unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins (What's in the Bag?). It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 2; it unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 3 begins (Welcome to Vice City). It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 4; it unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero). It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and the story gold. Complete the final mission of the game (Starting From Zero, Chapter 4). It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations and 15 of 18 meditations. Nothing toward it is missable; everything is doable in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; mix them freely. Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which you have done. The story introduces most of them and the rest are marked on the map (blue dumbbell icons); you will likely finish this naturally while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The gold medals are not punishing; work through the ranges as you unlock them and use a range guide for the tricky ones. Progress is tracked in the trophy list, and all ranges are required for the 100% checklist too.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). The locations are marked on the map; win one race at each spot. You do not need to win every race, just one per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you are fastest at — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the 20. Track them on the map; each location only needs one win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline; the challenge itself is a straightforward fishing contest.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (interact with the controllers, available from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all the levels of any one game once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); he calls, then is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving at shipwrecks — use the metal detector to dig treasures from the ocean floor and bring them back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets of quests. He goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable; track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and the like do not. The confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (street racing: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (deliveries: The Last Mile, Pete's Deliveries). More strangers are still being found; check the trophy tracker to see how many you have done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's Wish List is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. He wants 16 specific sports cars delivered; track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars in fixed spots, but you can steal any of them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. The Zorrusso itself is delivered during the story mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City. Destroy the labs (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house and is gone after Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. Do this when it is offered. The last meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. It is still unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do that first quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest (retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities; all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. Which exact animal unlocks it is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; there are 18 card-set locations in total and you need any 3 complete sets. Use a collectible guide to find them — they are small and easy to walk past, so a map checklist is the practical way to do this.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold up on the D-pad then R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you pass them — there are far more than 100, so any 100 will do. The categories are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Just scan things as you explore and this pops on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges and you only need 50; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this unlocks on the way. Track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark shows completed ones). Most complete naturally while working on other trophies; save the easiest remaining ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together (call your partner with hold D-pad right + Triangle). Build 4 stars, then escape — a fast sports bike through traffic works, or drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and while robbing bank vaults, so you may get it without trying.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. With your partner beside you, hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level — do not let it drop or escalate to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). A reliable spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; loot a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad) and hold R1 to scan vehicles as they pass — scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives by. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this pops early. Track totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Aim a firearm and press L3+R3 to trigger Combat Focus — time slows and weak spots are highlighted while the purple focus bar drains. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle). Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle (the Duke 556 is a good pick); wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets much easier as you level it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the ones on the open airfield do not count; it must be connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (it is slightly delayed). You can also walk in through the terminal on foot.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot a few enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick; kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. Leave clean and it pops shortly after. A good first target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it is the introduction to bank vault robberies and counts as your first. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank; when the guard carries the cash in and the vault opens, go in and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold D-pad right to hand off a bag. After that, Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 (do his earlier quests first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans). Robbing a vault instantly gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs; you need 5 for this trophy and all 8 for the 100% checklist, paying up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. You will get this automatically while doing Maximum Withdrawal. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. It is a long, peaceful flight; do it after the story when you have a plane and the time.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked by yellow map icons when you go near them (many are also marked from story progress). You only need one per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% checklist, so it comes automatically. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar. That is all it takes.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need one specific car: the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the Banshee, then drive forward straight through the showroom window — the trophy pops a moment after you are out on the street. No other car counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. This is the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first, you need them for the safe. It is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, grab the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not have to grab all three in one visit — if you miss one, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for it. Killing the enemies is not required.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Buy a gym membership and always work out together — call your partner with hold D-pad right + Triangle; while you train with one character, the other finishes their training automatically, so progress is doubled. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City (filter Map > Activities, dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on the notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you see the little demon face whenever an action counts. Your profile shifts between Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — which is permanent if you keep using excessive violence, so avoid it. It accumulates passively across robberies and fights; if you are short at the end, the fastest farm is running over civilians and cops with a car, though that pushes your profile toward Psycho.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED. No verified trigger exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Do not chase rumoured methods — this guide will not invent one. Check back: the moment a trigger is verified by a named source, this entry will be updated.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. On the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, go solo. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — it is a random spawn, so if it is not there, drive away and come back. When it is there, follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Walk up to it and it drops the woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians with a melee drive-by within 60 seconds. Ride a motorcycle or a push bike and press Square to kick pedestrians as you pass them. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City or Ocean Beach — and keep moving; ten kicks inside a minute is the whole challenge.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist; a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000, but vaults only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — just buy what you want and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (there are 4 more story garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become buyable after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); a notification tells you the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the cash, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first — each one adds parking spots, and you need somewhere to keep the registered cars. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
